ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, $AC$ is a chord, and $\angle BAC=25^\circ$. A point D is arbitrarily chosen on $\odot O$, and point D and point C are located on opposite sides of diameter $AB$. Connecting $AD$ and $DC$, what is the measure of $\angle D$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw line $BC$, as shown in the diagram,\\
since $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$,\\
thus $\angle ACB=90^\circ$,\\
since $\angle BAC=25^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle B=65^\circ$,\\
since $\overset{\frown}{AC}=\overset{\frown}{AC}$,\\
therefore $\angle D=\angle B=\boxed{65^\circ}$;
